title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton residents warned to keep pets out of Ames Pond following a dog's death linked to possible algae bloom.
Weekly tests at Ames Pond showed no E. Coli issues, but an algae bloom is suspected to impact water safety.
Cyanobacteria, forming toxic algae blooms, pose health risks to humans and can be lethal to pets, officials warn.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Former NH state trooper James Lamoureux decertified for misleading police about GPS tracking his girlfriend.
Lamoureux pleaded guilty to false reports; his six-month prison sentence is suspended for two years.
He resigned and will be placed on the national registry of decertified officers, banning future law enforcement employment.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to a report of a man with a gun at Grace Chapel, triggering a lockdown.
The 'gun' was actually a powder horn being polished by an avid period reenactor waiting for his wife.
Police confirmed there was no threat, with the incident drawing a heavy response and road closures.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Sports analyst Rob Parker doubts the Red Sox can maintain their performance and make the 2026 playoffs.
The Red Sox secured the second A.L. wild-card spot with a record of 64-52 after a winning streak.
FanGraphs gives the Red Sox a 96% chance of making playoffs and 83.4% odds for a wild-card spot.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was scratched from the Red Sox lineup Saturday due to leg swelling after being hit during Friday's game.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return for Sunday's game against the Athletics after receiving additional treatment.
Abreu ranks second in home runs (20) and RBIs (62) for Boston this season with a .256 average and .793 OPS.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics on Saturday.
Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs in 5.1 innings, marking his 13th start of the season for the Red Sox.
The Red Sox remain 1.5 games behind the Yankees in the AL's first wild-card spot, holding their second-place position.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is installing a second turf surface this summer due to NFL compliance issues.
The newly installed post-World Cup turf lacked NFL laboratory approval required for surfaces without an 'E-layer'.
The original pre-World Cup turf will be re-installed, as testing cannot occur until the procedural window in 2027.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, with goals from Guilherme and Agustin Resch.
Jack Harrison made his Revolution debut, entering in the 55th minute, showing promise despite not impacting the scoreline.
Houston Dynamo maintained defensive discipline and capitalized on a corner kick to secure their 63rd-minute goal and the victory.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony is training with a pitching machine to increase his batting velocity amid recovery from a wrist injury.
Adley Rutschman began a rehab stint with the Worcester Red Sox, catching for five innings in his first appearance.
Rutschman and Anthony's returns are expected to strengthen a Boston Red Sox team currently on a nine-game winning streak.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: "Clueless" (1995), "Eighth Grade" (2018), and "Something’s Gotta Give" (2003) are top Netflix picks this August.
"Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender" and "The Ballad of Wallis Island" stream on Paramount+ and Peacock, respectively.
"Ted Lasso" returns for its fourth season on Apple TV, garnering praise for its depth and genuine character portrayals.
